newsitem.title: FRANCE: ETA tracked French officer after leader's arrest.
newsitem.headline: ETA tracked French officer after leader's arrest.

text.p: The Basque separatist guerrilla group ETA tracked a senior French officer in Bordeaux, southwestern France, after the arrest of senior movement leader Jose Luis Urrusolo Sistiaga, police sources said on Monday.

Investigators said they had found undated notes which included information on a vehicle used by the officer when he was billeted in Bordeaux. Police sources said the documents did not prove that the officer was "a potential target" for the ETA.

Urrusolo Sistiaga, 39 and said to be the ETA's third-ranking leader, was detained on January 16 after crashing through a police barrier. Investigators believed he was in charge of commandos of the ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom).
ETA has killed some 800 people since 1968 in its campaign for an independent Basque state.
